unit: URI handler and HTML description service
notes: Adds the headless URI handler and HTML description service in Playnite.Core with no Avalonia, network, child process or shell use. PlayniteUriRoute parses and strictly validates playnite:// routes: start/<guid>[/<0-999>], showgame/<guid>, search[/<term>], view/desktop|fullscreen and filter/<field>/<value> for the p6-001 stored-filter fields, plus plugin sources matched case-insensitively; the whole URI is bounded (2048 chars, 32 arguments, 1024 per argument), rejects control characters, unescaped whitespace, query/fragment/backslash, traversal, bad percent escapes, invalid UTF-8 and decoded control characters, and rejects the v10 creatediag/installaddon commands as unsupported in v1 (diagnostics packaging is out of scope, add-on install is p6-010). UriHandlerApi keeps the v10 IUriHandlerAPI registration contract (reserved playnite source, duplicate and invalid names rejected, absent remove is a no-op) and dispatches application routes through an injectable IUriCommandHost; malformed input is Rejected before any host call, a missing host is Unavailable while plugin sources keep working, host/handler failures are explicit Failed results, and caller cancellation propagates. HtmlDescriptionService consumes an injectable IHtmlDescriptionProvider and IHtmlSanitizer, with HtmlDescriptionSanitizer as the total default: documented allowlist of passive elements, only a validated absolute http/https href (no credentials) survives with rel=noreferrer noopener, script/style/iframe/object/embed/svg/math/template content is removed, entities are decoded before link validation and re-escaped, depth is bounded at 64 and input at 256 KiB, so no script, event handler, style or remote resource injection remains. Provider missing/blank is Empty, a failure keeps its reason, exceptions and null results are stable Failed diagnostics, and cancellation propagates. Tests via fakes cover route parse/validation matrices (malformed, traversal, injection, entity, UTF-8 and limits), dispatch outcomes and sanitisation cases; zero skips. The p6-005 metadata document is adapted by the host through the provider seam; the Avalonia.HtmlRenderer view path stays with the Phase 7 shell, so Core gains no UI reference. The v10-named interface lives in Core for now because Abstractions PublicAPI and the api-baseline are protected; p6-008 owns that move and freeze. No protected oracle, baseline, aggregate or other unit's files are changed.
